description: approve() stores approvedDiscount rounded down to a 5 bps grid instead of the reviewed discount
withdraw() sets the status directly and writes no WITHDRAWN history event
decline() no longer calls requireNotRequester, so a requester-reviewer can decline their own request
create() drops the active-request pre-check and the mapper always stores a NULL active_application_id, so the unique index protects nothing
decline() only rejects WITHDRAWN and SUPERSEDED, so APPROVED and DECLINED requests can be declined again
decide() no longer calls requireOpen for APPROVED, so a request on a closed application can be approved
Extracts requireApplicationOpen(applicationId) helper in the service; behaviour unchanged
Mapper: extracts approvedDiscountOf(entity) and a storedCount local; behaviour unchanged
